about: WG.33.01 explicit visualStateId -> catalogue mapping for tools/verify_world_state_registry.js (Lane X, 2026-09-26). Only ACCEPTED rows resolve a registry visual state (WSR-03) and trace catalogue slots (WSR-04). PROPOSED rows are candidates shown next to the gap in the report and change nothing. Every row below is PROPOSED by Lane X on a literal basis only (the visual state and the catalogue source share a word); none is a ruling. Accepting a row (status ACCEPTED) is a Coordinator/Owner decision; the stale-baseline check then forces the matching known_gaps.json entries out. A target is {"entryId": <catalogue entry id>} or {"sourceId": <a source id cited in entries[].sourceIds>} (every entry citing it).
